task: Pin the Narwhal IDP Portal image to the published release 1.1.8 (was 1.1.7); the repository change is static and no cluster rollout was performed.

events.summary: Tag bump of one image in the GitOps manifest, its air-gap inventory and digest pin, the docs that quote the pin, and the committed OSS-updates snapshot regenerated from VERSIONS.md. No manifest structure, env, RBAC or chart change. No merge, no Gitea push and no cluster rollout in this change.

ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.8 was published from tag portal/v1.1.8 on e9bf432d (#595): the Portal Release workflow completed successfully. Checked 2026-11-06T06:10:33Z: the tag resolves to index digest sha256:500c334ed8d0095cdd0f1a7d7ce67442f43ff1852db13ebb7dfcba017a420a76 and cosign verify with scripts/airgap/keys/cosign.pub passes on it. Local Vagrant nodes pull ghcr.io directly; a cluster whose nodes cannot reach ghcr.io must mirror by digest first (scripts/airgap/README.md, Mirror a pin bump).

Pin moved 1.1.7 -> 1.1.8 in the Deployment image, images.txt and image-digests.tsv (new digest), gitops README pins and prose (en/ko), VERSIONS.md (IDP Portal row and Next.js 16.4.2 -> 16.4.3), compatibility-matrix, SECURITY.md example and the Unreleased changelog entries (en/ko); portal/src/data/oss-versions.generated.json regenerated with gen-oss-versions.mjs because VERSIONS.md changed. 1.1.8 shows an em dash instead of Unknown in the DORA history rows (#581) and bumps Next.js to 16.4.3 (#486).
Local static checks only; no live cluster verification was run for this pin.
